posts.title: Build your first application with Claude Code and Spec-Driven Development
posts.description: Stop babysitting the chat. Spec-driven development is the type of development that allows you to go hiking while your agent does the heavy lifting.

posts.title: We're all CTOs now
posts.description: Success (and fun) in working with AI and agents in particular depends less on technical skill than you might think.

posts.title: Prioritizing yourself isn't selfish. It's the prerequisite.
posts.description: The first thing I sacrifice when the week gets loud is the one part of my day that keeps me steady — my morning. But protecting my energy isn't selfish. It's the prerequisite for showing up fully for everyone who's counting on me.
